name: FERAL FEMME
description: FERAL FEMME is an educational activism platform that examines animal testing in the skincare and beauty industry through calm, research-based awareness. We publish primary-source research, plain-language explainers, and a public regulation tracker.

pillars.title: Research
pillars.summary: We read the regulation, the test guidelines, and the peer-reviewed literature — then cite them in full.
pillars.detail: Every claim on this platform is traceable to a primary source: a regulation, an OECD test guideline, a validation report, or a published study. Where evidence is contested, we say so.

pillars.title: Educate
pillars.summary: We translate regulatory language into plain English without flattening its complexity.
pillars.detail: Legislation is written to be precise, not to be understood. Our explainers keep the precision and remove the barrier, so that a shopper, a student, and a policy researcher can all use the same page.

pillars.title: Empower
pillars.summary: Understanding a system is the precondition for changing it.
pillars.detail: We do not tell people what to buy. We give them the structure of the industry, the meaning of each certification, and the questions worth asking — and let them decide.

newsletter.name: The Dispatch
newsletter.summary: One monthly briefing on regulatory movement, method validation, and industry disclosure. No promotions. No affiliate links. Unsubscribe in one click.
newsletter.note: Set `newsletter.action` in content/site.json to your provider's form endpoint (Buttondown, ConvertKit, MailerLite, Listmonk). Until then the form degrades to a mailto: link.

support.headline: This platform is funded by its readers
support.summary: FERAL FEMME takes no money from cosmetics manufacturers, retailers, or certification bodies. It carries no advertising and no affiliate links. That independence is only possible because readers pay for it directly.

tiers.name: Reader
tiers.summary: Keeps the archive open and free for everyone.
benefits: Early access to new research before publication
Named in the annual funding report (optional)

tiers.name: Researcher
tiers.summary: Funds a working day of primary-source research each quarter.
benefits: Full citation exports (BibTeX / RIS) for every study
Quarterly regulation digest with change tracking
Access to working notes and source documents

tiers.name: Institution
tiers.summary: For libraries, departments, NGOs, and newsrooms.
benefits: Site-wide licence for classroom and internal use
Slide decks and lesson plans for every module
Direct line for research and fact-checking requests

oneOff.label: One-off contribution
oneOff.summary: A single contribution of any size, with no ongoing commitment.

support.note: Set each tier's `link` to a Stripe Payment Link, Ko-fi, or Open Collective URL. Empty links render as an enquiry mailto: so the page never ships a dead button.

licensing.summary: Schools, universities, and organisations can license the FERAL FEMME curriculum for teaching and internal training.

packages.name: Classroom
includes: All learning modules as editable slide decks
Lesson plans with learning outcomes and assessment prompts
Printable source packs for seminar use

packages.name: Institution
includes: Two live sessions per year, remote

packages.name: Commissioned Research
includes: Written report with full citation apparatus

brand.proportions: 60% Soft Blush · 25% Deep Crimson · 10% Pure Black · 5% Clean White

analytics.note: Set provider to 'plausible' or 'umami' plus `src` to enable a cookieless, GDPR-friendly analytics script. Left empty, no third-party script is emitted at all.
